How this works

  1. Each stop has website, directions and add to calendar — tap whichever you need.
  2. Skip anything you'd rather not go to; the day rearranges itself. Love it quietly marks a favourite.
  3. Take a photo of anything you try on and leave a note. Try-on photos stay on this phone.
  4. When you're done, tap Email my picks or Text my picks — it comes straight to me.
